spec_match.rationale:
Presets are real SanitizerConfigs passed to new Sanitizer(); the comment, strict and plain-text presets add replaceWithChildrenElements because Chrome 158 deletes the text inside unlisted wrappers (elements:[] on "

Para

" gives "").

interactive.rationale: Preset cards and Apply re-render with genuinely different output per policy (verified: comment keeps b/i/a[href] and drops p/h2 with content; rich keeps p/h2; strict keeps only a[href]; text-only is empty).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card text now matches behaviour: plain-text unwraps common wrappers so text survives; script/style/media disappear with their content.

edge_cases.rationale: Shows replaceWithChildrenElements, invalid-config TypeError (role=alert), and an honest unsupported state with no regex+innerHTML fallback.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus and MDN; the HTML Standard link is on the feature page and sibling concepts, not this page.

conformance.rationale: Unchanged immutable suite (7/7 pass on Chrome 158, mostly existence checks; its specUrl still points at the retired WICG draft). New behavioural facts verified on Chrome 158 that a human could add as a NEW suite: setHTML with elements:["script"] and attributes:["onclick"] still drops both; elements:[] deletes wrapped text; elements+removeElements throws TypeError; the default drops .

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 via Node Playwright on the local server, at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800, plus a run with Element.prototype.setHTML/Sanitizer deleted before load to exercise the unsupported path. chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment, so this is NOT DevTools-MCP verification (rule 7b); DOM semantics were checked by script. All four presets by click and keyboard, Apply, and an onerror payload driven; 0 console errors, no handler ran.

telemetry_health.rationale: The capability check now calls window.showcaseTelemetry.support() with supported/unsupported, on top of the shared runtime capture. No interaction events.

design_system.rationale: Cards are native buttons styled with variables; the literal <\/script> artefact in the textarea is gone.

accessibility.rationale: Preset cards are buttons in a labelled group with aria-pressed, operable by Enter/Space; the textarea has a visible <label>; the result region is aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow and every button >= 44px at 360x740 DPR3.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify with chrome-devtools-mcp and inspect the accessibility tree
openQuestions.detail: The 2026-11-24 fix pass also used Playwright (Chrome for Testing 158) because chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in the cloud environment.

openQuestions.title: Add a config-builder concept covering removeElements, removeAttributes, comments, dataAttributes and the Sanitizer mutator methods
openQuestions.detail: Still open (additive new slug). Chrome 158 exposes allowElement, removeElement, replaceElementWithChildren, allowAttribute, removeAttribute, setComments, setDataAttributes, removeUnsafe and get().

guidanceConsulted.query: associated labels, toggle buttons with aria-pressed, status messages for sanitizer results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Associate every <label> via for/id, expose toggle state with aria-pressed on native buttons, and announce results with role=status / <output>.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: labels for every textarea, preset cards became buttons with aria-pressed, role=toolbar on the editor toolbar, role=status on support notes and logs, <output> meters.

guidanceConsulted.query: minimum touch target size for buttons on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Size targets from a --target-size token (24px, 44px under pointer: coarse) with min-block-size; size the label for checkboxes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied to all buttons; the strict-lane checkbox sits inside a 44px label. 0px overflow at 360x740.

summary: Fixed 2026-11-24: real setHTML()/Sanitizer behaviour only (no regex or walker imitation in unsupported browsers), accurate SanitizerConfig usage including replaceWithChildrenElements, real before/after diffs, HTML Standard references, and accessible native controls.
